description: a cylinder R 1, 2 tall, minus a cylinder of the same radius whose axis is parallel and 2R away, clearing both caps: the walls touch from outside along the ruling x = 0, y = R, a tangent contact that removes no material, so the result is the target with every id kept (2/3/3/3). The contact lies off both seams, which run along +x. Open CASCADE imprints the ruling on the wall, a convention Arris does not follow, stated in counts_differ as tangent-outside-cut's (plans/cylinder-cylinder-booleans step 6)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the tangent ruling on the target's wall and splits the two rim circles it meets; Arris keeps the wall whole — a touch from outside removes no material and makes no edge
